column2: According to the Resolution No.62/NO-DBD dated 29 March 2024 of the General Shareholders Meeting on approval of 2023 profit distribution and 2024 profit distribution plan, the Corporation made appropriation as below: > Additional appropriation to the bonus and welfare funds with the amount of VND 6,959,000,000 from 2023 profit after tax; and Estimated appropriation to the bonus and welfare funds with the amount of VND 106,000,000,000 from 2024 estimated profit after tax.
